Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_Enabled_tooltip: Enable room designations and editing. Existing private storage policies remain fail-closed if unavailable.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_RoomTileLimit_tool: Maximum tiles in one saved logical room. Existing larger rooms remain readable; edits must fit the current limit.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_RoomEditRange_tool: Maximum horizontal tile distance for editing room geometry. Native access and per-floor membership still apply.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_RoomDoorways_toolt: Treat verified doorless frames as structural detection boundaries. Actual doors remain boundaries even when open.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_DelegatedRooms_too: Allow delegated private room storage policies for integrated mods. This does not secure unrelated vanilla actions. Existing private policies fail closed when disabled.
